situations.headline: South32 to divest bauxite/alumina/aluminium assets to Alcoa for $3.1bn cash + Alcoa stock

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: South32 to divest bauxite/alumina/aluminium assets to Alcoa for $3.1bn cash + Alcoa stock (interest 6, risk 4)

thesis.text: South32 is monetizing its aluminium value chain assets via a $3.1bn cash + Alcoa equity deal, with the stock portion largely flowed through to shareholders via in-specie distribution, creating a cleaner, more focused portfolio and a potential Alcoa CDI arbitrage/flow trade around the October 15, 2026 shareholder vote and subsequent distribution mechanics.
